about: Single source of the locked e-mail footer (#1081). Read by lockedFooter.js (editor block, starter e-mail) and by EmailCampaigns::LockedFooter (AI prompt, sanitizer fallback). Brand-neutral pt-BR; text #4b5563 on #f4f4f4 (contrast >= 4.5, WCAG AA); explicit Arial so MJML imports no web font.
